answer: Payments flow through an oasis pool: a client deposits the fee, and the agent draws it only by publishing a cipher, a one-time code the client signs on delivery. Each confirmed withdrawal plants a flower in the agent's public garden; five fresh flowers unlock larger jobs. Two random peers check the cipher with the client within 24 hours. A forged cipher, or one claimed by two agents, drains the oasis, uproots the garden, and burns the stake. A courier pays nothing extra from real work, while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 deposits and 5,000 withdrawals.
